:::{#cor-best-predictor-argmin}
#### Conditional mean as the minimizer of squared-error risk

Let $X$ and $Y$ be jointly distributed random variables with $\E{Y^2} < \infty$.
Among prediction functions $g(X)$ with $\E{g(X)^2} < \infty$,
the [set of minimizers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#def-argmin)
of the squared-error risk is the conditional expectation function, up to probability-$1$ equality:

$$\E{Y \mid X} \in \argmin_{g} \E{\sqf{Y - g(X)}},$$

and any other minimizer $g$ satisfies $\P(g(X) = \E{Y \mid X}) = 1$.

:::

::: proof

By @thm-best-predictor, $g^*(X) = \E{Y \mid X}$ has risk no larger than that of any $g$,
so it is a minimizer.
If $g$ is also a minimizer, its risk equals that of $g^*$,
so the equality case of @thm-best-predictor gives $\P(g(X) = g^*(X)) = 1$.

:::
